name: La Rata Remix
author: La Rata
description: Seeded chaos for 1-4 players with six interactive card boosters, an expanded card collection, relic removal and run statistics for supported relic effects. An expanded Rat King finale with two Kingsguard escorts. English, German and Simplified Chinese localization. Requires game v0.107.1 and BaseLib 3.4.7. Start a new run.
